newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air sees Q2 as more challenging.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air sees Q2 as more challenging.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Tuesday the second quarter is expected to be more challenging than the first, with little improvement seen in fuel prices and the yen remaining weak.

"The year-over-year operating results indicate that the first quarter was challenging and the second quarter looks to be more so," Jim Lawrence, chief financial officer, said in a statement. "We are forecasting demand to remain strong in the North American system. But less positively, we don't expect much improvement in fuel prices year-over-year and we expect the yen to continue to be weak."
